name: aegis_prices_live_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: AEGIS_PRICES_LIVE_20261107 — Aegis prices are live marks and say where they came from.
aegis_synthesis._resolve_price and aegis_evening_packet._holdings_protection both priced a holding from a
stored value (holdings row 'price', holdings.json read directly). They now resolve through the shared
resolve_mark helper (Finviz cache at most 30 min, else a fresh Schwab/Alpaca/moomoo quote from the data
broker) and carry source + as-of into the brief text; a stored mark is a last resort flagged STALE. The
packet reads its holdings document DB-first. Listing it schedules nothing.
